title: Large number of Chinese students using AI tools, nationwide survey finds (China Daily)
notes: China Daily (state media), English report on the 8,563-student survey. Supports: >60% used AI, ~1 in 5 regularly, 71% homework, 20.5% rely-on-AI-to-think (rural 22.8%), 46.4% prefer AI over real people when upset, 21% anxiety. MOE 2025 two guidelines, tiered approach.
